indice-combinado-de-seca.title: Drought in a single classification
indice-combinado-de-seca.description: The Combined Drought Indicator brings together rainfall, soil moisture and vegetation in a single map, using the European Drought Observatory methodology adapted to Brazil.

territorios-tradicionais.title: Traditional territories on the map
territorios-tradicionais.description: Indigenous Lands, Quilombola Territories, Settlements and Protected Areas as layers, to see how drought and degradation cross them.

relatorio-por-municipio.title: A report for each of the 5,570 municipalities
relatorio-por-municipio.description: Type the name, choose the themes and get a diagnosis of your municipality in seconds.

priorizacao-por-recorte.title: Priorities for the area you choose
priorizacao-por-recorte.description: Brazil, region, state, biome, Semi-arid or ASD: combine indicators with the weights that make sense for your question and see, on the map, which municipalities need action first, with results exportable to spreadsheet and PDF.
